recovery_criterion.definition: recovered = all final centers inside the fluid mesh (raw feasibility) AND max matched center error <= 1.0 m AND max matched amplitude error <= 0.01
recovery_criterion.matching: run_optimization.match_sources_by_permutation: label permutation minimizing the TOTAL center position error; amplitude errors taken under that same permutation (the convention of optimization_summary.json recovery_permutation_matched)
recovery_criterion.note: used only for post-hoc reporting; it never stops or alters an optimization. Continuous errors are stored for every run so other thresholds can be applied.
